description: The plot illustrates the MC1 scores of SEA using a varying number of demonstrations, with a higher score indicating better performance. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick labels at intervals of 250. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and has a linear scale, ranging from 45 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot contains four lines: a black line with square markers representing "Squared-Exponential", a blue line representing "Truth", a green line representing "ELU", and a red dashed line representing "LLaMA-2-chat-7B". The black "Squared-Exponential" line starts at around 46 at 0 demonstrations and increases to approximately 54 at 1500 demonstrations, with a notable rise between 0 and 250 demonstrations. The blue "Truth" line begins at around 54.5 at 0 demonstrations and remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 54.5 at 1500 demonstrations. The green "ELU" line starts at around 54 at 0 demonstrations and remains steady, ending at approximately 54 at 1500 demonstrations. The red dashed "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line remains constant at around 46 across the entire range of demonstrations.
